name: machine-as-tool
title: Refund approval (machine as a stateless tool)

comparison.purpose: Embed a whole agent machine inside one tool call of a host harness, with no framework and no run store: the handle IS the persisted snapshot, so start/resume are pure functions of a JSON blob. The policy check branches in a choice state, so a small refund auto-approves without ever pausing and only an over-limit one comes back with an interaction. See mastra-host for the same bridge inside a real framework, with a store-keyed handle.

starters.label: Large refund ($780) — over the approval limit
